01 · About me

Hi there!

Long story short

I'm adept with computers and emerging technologies. Adaptability is my forte — I thrive on diverse challenges and consistently deliver tasks to the highest standards. Alongside my strong sense of responsibility, I effortlessly connect with people, fostering positive relationships in any setting.

I'm also passionate about the arts, enjoy finding bugs in applications as a tester, and love creating commercial skits and stories. With experience using various kinds of software, I create unique and compelling content.

Today I'm Co-Founder & CMO at Matech, a payment terminal software company in the UAE, where I lead brand and design. I'm a Creative Computing graduate with First-Class Honours, trained across design, code and storytelling. Two years in fleet operations taught me to plan tight and stay calm when things break.

CerePay POS

Elemental Palette

Nine elemental themes for the CerePay terminal. Each one changes the look. None of them changes the product. The colours lighting this page come from it.

Lock the product

Layout, copy and motion follow the Mercury 2 default on every theme. Staff learn one terminal, not nine.
